 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. UConn men's basketball coach Dan Hurley started his college coaching career at Wagner , where he led one of the most impressive two-year turnarounds that the sports has ever seen.
 In a full-circle moment, the Huskies will host Wagner on Monday night at Gampel Pavilion but don't expect Hurley to feel sentimental about the game.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement "I don't think you're very sentimental about any opponents when you play the game and prepare for a game, because you've got a chance to be successful when your preparation and intensity and attention to detail and urgency and execution is the same regardless of the opponent," Hurley said at practice on Sunday.
 UConn is coming off an impressive win over Michigan, defeating the Wolverines 85-77 in Boston last Friday in a national championship rematch. Hurley said he expects everyone to be healthy and available for Monday's game.
 Wagner is still searching for its first win after falling to Boston College and Miami.
